    <script>
        require(["jquery", "ajax", "cookies", "toastr", "neolifeCMS"], function ($, ajax, cookies, toastr, neolifeCMS) {
            // Settings            
            var languageCookieName = 'NeolifeSelectedLanguage',
                countryCookieName = 'NeolifeSelectedCountry',
                shoppingCountryCookieName = 'NeolifeShoppingCountry';
            
            // Helpers
            var helpers = {
                overrideCMSLinks: function () {
                    var $cmsOverrideLinks = $('.exigo-override-link');
                    $cmsOverrideLinks.each(function (index) {
                        var rootUrl = location.origin,
                            overridenUrl = rootUrl + $(this).attr("data-urlendpoint");
                        $(this).attr("href", overridenUrl);
                    });
                }                
            };

            function init() {
                neolifeCMS.FillPage(cookies.get(languageCookieName), cookies.get(countryCookieName), undefined, cookies.get(shoppingCountryCookieName));
                setTimeout(function () {
                    helpers.overrideCMSLinks();
                }, 1000);
            }

            init();
        });
    </script>

    
    <script>
    require(["jquery", "ajax", "cookies", "urls", "app", "toastr", "neolifeCMS", "forms", "bootstrap", "login", "fsModal"], function ($, ajax, cookies, url, app, toastr, CMS) {

        // Settings
        var context = '#view-sitelogin-na-aunz',
            $context = $(context),
            cookiename = 'NeolifeLoginName',
            getCultureCodeURL = '/app/getculturecode',
            timeZoneCookieName = 'NeolifeTimeZoneIANA',
            oneYearFromNow = '9/2/2027',
            languageCookieName = 'NeolifeSelectedLanguage',
            countryCookieName = 'NeolifeSelectedCountry',
            shoppingCountryCookieName = 'NeolifeShoppingCountry',
            landingUrl = ('False' == "True") ? '/authentication/continue' : '/';

        // Event Handlers
        function registerEventHandlers() {

            /* Event fired when <i> is clicked */
            $('#togglePassword', $context).on('click', function () {
                $(this).toggleClass("fa-eye fa-eye-slash")
                $('#Password').attr('type') === 'password' ? $('#Password').attr('type', 'text') : $('#Password').attr('type', 'password')
            });
            // Login Form
            $('#loginbutton', $context).on('click', function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                $("#loginbutton").buttonState("loading");
                actions.signin();
            });
            $('input', $context).on('keypress', function (event) {
                if (event.which == 13) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    actions.signin();
                }
            });
            $('[data-market]').on("click", function () {
                var countryCode = $(this).data("market");
                cookies.set(countryCookieName, countryCode, {
                    expires: new Date(oneYearFromNow),
                    path: '/'
                });
                ajax.json({
                    url: getCultureCodeURL,
                    data: { countryCode },
                    success: function (response) {
                        if (response.success) {
                            cookies.set(languageCookieName, response.cultureCode, {
                                expires: new Date(oneYearFromNow),
                                path: '/'
                            });
                            location.reload();
                        }
                    }
                });
            });
            $('[data-language]').on("click", function () {
                var languageID = $(this).data("language");

                cookies.set(languageCookieName, languageID, {
                    expires: new Date(oneYearFromNow),
                    path: '/'
                });
                location.reload();
            });
        }


        // Actions
        var actions = {
            clearCookies: function () {
                cookies.clear(cookiename);
            },
            loadCookies: function () {
                var savedLoginName = cookies.get(cookiename);
                if (savedLoginName) $('#LoginName').val(savedLoginName);
            },
            saveCookies: function () {
                // Get the expiration date of the cookie
                var expires = new Date();
                expires.setDate(expires.getDate() + 365);

                // Set the cookies
                cookies.set(cookiename, $('#LoginName').val(), {
                    expires: expires
                });
            },
            signin: function () {

                // Validate the form
                if (!$('form', $context).valid()) {
                    $("#loginbutton").buttonState("reset");
                    return false;
                }

                // Submit the form
                ajax.json({
                    url: '/login',
                    data: $('form').serializeObject(),
                    beforeSend: function () {
                        toastr.clear();
                    },
                    success: function (response) {
                        if (!response.Status) {
                            actions.throwError(Resources.Common.LoginFailed, response.ErrorMessage);
                            $("#loginbutton").buttonState("reset");
                        }
                        else {
                            // Save the cookies
                            actions.saveCookies();

                            localStorage.clear();

                            // Redirect
                            var decodedUrlQueryReturnUrl = decodeURIComponent(url.current.queryKey.ReturnUrl || landingUrl);
                            var finalLandingUrl = (decodedUrlQueryReturnUrl != "/") ? decodedUrlQueryReturnUrl : landingUrl;

                            window.location = (response.RedirectUrl != '') ? response.RedirectUrl : finalLandingUrl;
                        }
                    },
                    error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                        actions.throwError(Resources.Common.LoginFailed, error);
                        $("#loginbutton").buttonState("reset");
                    }
                });
            },
            throwError: function (title, error) {
                toastr.error(error, title);
                $('#Password').focus();
                $("#loginbutton").buttonState("reset");
            },
            handleCMS: function() {
                var $help = $('#help-modal div[data-cms-section="help"]');
                if ($help) {
                    $help.attr("data-cms-product", "login");
                    CMS.FillPage(cookies.get(languageCookieName), cookies.get(countryCookieName),);
                }
            }
        };


        // Initialization
        function _init() {
            cookies.set(timeZoneCookieName, Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone, {
                expires: new Date(oneYearFromNow),
                path: '/',
                domain: false,
                secure: false
            });

            // Register the event handlers
            registerEventHandlers();

            // Load the saved cookies into the form
            actions.loadCookies();

            actions.handleCMS();

            // Focus on the right field
            if ($('#LoginName').val() == '') $('#LoginName').focus();
            else $('#Password').focus();
        }
        _init();

    });
    </script>
